statpacks.name: Adept
statpacks.description: Your will leads the way.

statpacks.name: Alert
statpacks.description: You sharpened both your body and your mind as best you were able, and vigilance has been your reward.

statpacks.name: Austere
statpacks.description: You've kept your humors balanced, your body honed and mind sharp enough. Fate has left you mostly unchanged, in every way.

statpacks.name: Aware
statpacks.description: Your keen senses have not led you astray.

statpacks.name: Deft
statpacks.description: Being quick on the draw has left you weaker when they live past your first strike.

statpacks.name: Dextrous
statpacks.description: You see. You dash. You spring. You dodge. Can you keep it up?

statpacks.name: Diligent
statpacks.description: You take your time, but you have a lot of it to spare.

statpacks.name: Enduring
statpacks.description: You've spent yils willingly submitting your body through a most perilous journey. Stalwart in your faith, you've sworn to never flee again.

statpacks.name: Fated
statpacks.description: The first or the last - let destiny's fickle loom decree what your fate shall be.

statpacks.name: Foresighted
statpacks.description: You see what is and what will sometimes be.

statpacks.name: Frail
statpacks.description: The growing dark lines your vision more with every passing day: your flesh and mind are failing you, and destiny has turned her gaze from you. How will your tale endure such hardship?

statpacks.name: Hardy
statpacks.description: Uniquely Pestran fortitude affords you the means to shrug off illnesses and poisons that others might not.

statpacks.name: Industrious
statpacks.description: You waste no time. You know enough to get by, and strive towards it.

statpacks.name: Muscular
statpacks.description: Hard labor has honed you into a mass of sinew - a valuable trait in a world where might makes right.

statpacks.name: Precise
statpacks.description: You've seen it all. You've heard it all. An eye to the horizon, and an ear to the ground, and the right place to strike.

statpacks.name: Resolute
statpacks.description: Look ever to the Gods for guidance in these trying times - and so you have, to the exclusion of the world around you.

statpacks.name: Struggler
statpacks.description: Lyfe's dealt you a poor hand, so you've opted to simply flip the table instead.

statpacks.name: Studious
statpacks.description: Your understanding of the world avails you, more often than not.

statpacks.name: Swift
statpacks.description: With the wind in your hair and trouble at your back, your speed has oft been your salvation.

statpacks.name: Taut
statpacks.description: Wound tight like the limbs of a time-teller, your physicality is poised to strike - or flee - at a moment's notice.

statpacks.name: Thuggish
statpacks.description: Your robust physique and keen eyes oft been your most valuable friends in such trying times.

statpacks.name: Toil-hardened
statpacks.description: Your lyfe, hard-lyved, has imparted one solitary adage: carry on above all else. And so you endure.

statpacks.name: Trained
statpacks.description: Years honing your physique has left you with a physical edge, but your faculties have been somewhat neglected.

statpacks.name: Tricky
statpacks.description: Swift feet with a mind to match and a tiny sliver of the Ten's own luck.

statpacks.name: Virtuous
statpacks.description: The breadth of my being is one of many, distinguished talents.   (Allows access to 'virtues', special traits/quirks that replace the bonus normally given by a statpack.)

statpacks.name: Wary
statpacks.description: Eyes forward, ever and always. A careful course has always seen you through... so far.

statpacks.name: Wretched
statpacks.description: The cruelty of Enigma leaves many in its wake - you among them. But with her terrible eye turned elsewhere, perhaps it is time for your fortune to be made...

statpacks.name: Zealous
statpacks.description: Faith in something drives your body and mind to match what neither can see.
